table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	code=purledger.purinvcode,   
	purcatcode=purledger.purcatcode,
	purtypecode=purledger.purtypecode,
	suppinvdate=purledger.suppinvdate,
	grn=purledger.grn,
	aliasname='            ',
	suppcode=purledger.suppcode,   
	suppinvcode=purledger.suppinvcode,
	pocode=purledger.pocode,   
	salesmancode=purledger.salesmancode,   
	date=purledger.date,   
	discperc=purledger.discperc,   
	flatdisc=purledger.flatdisc,   
	misccharges=purledger.misccharges,   
	salestax=purledger.salestax,   
	posted=purledger.posted,   
	postdate=purledger.postdate,   
	remarks=purledger.remarks, 
	invtotal=purledger.invtotal,  
	username=users.username,   
	address1=supplier.address1,   
	city=supplier.city,   
	phone=supplier.phone,   
	podate=Getdate(),   
	manfname='                                        '  ,   
	manfcode=0,
	originaldate=purledger.originaldate,
	modifiedby=purledger.modifiedby,
	postedby=purledger.postedby,
	porb=purledger.porb,
	headerno=purledger.headerno,
	gcode=0,
	suppbalance=0.00,
	creditordebit=' ',
	invgstperc1=purledger.invgstperc1,
	headerinvno=purledger.headerinvno,
	AccountFor=purledger.AccountFor,
	PaymentMode=purledger.PaymentMode,
	PaymentAccCode=purledger.PaymentAccCode,
	Amt=purledger.Amt,
	AmtBy=purledger.AmtBy,
	AmtDate=purledger.AmtDate,
	AmtReference=purledger.AmtReference,
	Outstandingamt=purledger.Outstandingamt,
	marked=purledger.marked
 
FROM 
	crs_purledger purledger,   
	users,   
	supplier,
	accounts  
WHERE
	( purledger.clientinstanceid = :r_clientinstanceid ) and  
	( purledger.suppcode = supplier.suppcode ) and  
	( purledger.suppcode = accounts.acccode )  and
	( purledger.salesmancode = users.usercode) and  
	( ( purledger.purinvcode = :r_InvCode ) )
